comparison.objective: Distribute six nested cones evenly along a curved road; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Top-tip extraction, repeated placement, and stable release versus recessed-key alignment, collar tuning, locking, and impact inspection.
comparison.success_condition: All cones upright, released, within centerline and spacing tolerances versus two safe stopping cycles and lock-retention tolerance. No separate spec versions were provided.
comparison.reason: Repeated geometric placement does not test dynamic adjustment.
